answer: Use a sequential proof-of-work puzzle bound to each key. At registration the network issues a seed from a public randomness pulse; the agent must compute a slow hash chain of ten million steps over its key and that seed, which cannot be parallelized. Verifiers check sampled checkpoints cheaply. Identity expires every month and needs a fresh chain. Each fake therefore occupies one dedicated CPU core, about four dollars monthly, so a thousand fakes cost thousands. Sandbar, dune, quartz miners gain nothing from splitting.
